description: Implementation of the PushPromisePayloadDecoder class for decoding HTTP/2 PUSH_PROMISE frames, including state management and callback reporting.

classes.name: PushPromisePayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for handling HTTP/2 PUSH_PROMISE frame payloads, managing decoding state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator to print the PayloadState enum value.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Initializes decoding of a PUSH_PROMISE payload, setting the state based on padding presence.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Continues decoding a PUSH_PROMISE payload, handling different payload states and calling appropriate callbacks.

methods.name: ReportPushPromise
methods.description: Notifies the listener about the start of a PUSH_PROMISE frame with relevant frame header and fields.
